open_errors.issue: Chinna is a woman everywhere else in the book ('a broad woman' ch1, 'her mat' ch4, 'her bad hip' ch14 and ch31). In ch13 Neela calls Chinna 'he'.

patches.find: Tell Chinna it's for the warden. He'll hurry.
patches.replace: Tell Chinna it's for the warden. She'll hurry.

open_errors.issue: The bible says Devan never lies to Neela. On the rampart he plainly has been laughing, yet he tells her 'I'm not.' That is a direct untruth to her.
open_errors.fix: Replace the denial with his stock refusal, which keeps the banter.

open_errors.issue: Devan says that on the wedding night she slipped the latch 'carefully, so the slat wouldn't ring'. In ch1 she deliberately presses the third slat so it creaks, and in ch2 Devan hears it creak. His memory also puts the latch after the turning, which is the wrong order.
open_errors.fix: Have him describe the leopard leaving instead of the latch.

patches.find: Then it slipped the latch like somebody who had done it before, carefully, so the slat wouldn't ring.
patches.replace: Then it looked away, and went over the ledge like something that had done it a hundred times.

open_errors.issue: Devan quotes Ittan's letter as saying 'I shall come myself this season, my friend, to see how the match has prospered.' The full letter read aloud in ch17 contains no such line. Ittan says the 'match has prospered' phrase only in person, in ch28.
open_errors.fix: Quote a line that actually appears in the ch17 letter.

patches.find: *I shall come myself this season, my friend, to see how the match has prospered.* He had thought it kindly meant.
patches.replace: *A man ought to look upon the gate he locks.* He had thought it kindly meant.

open_errors.issue: In ch12 Devan hid Asha's token in his sleeve before Neela came in, and he never shows it to her or describes its seal. In ch23 she nonetheless predicts the Keeper's tallies will match 'Asha's token'.
open_errors.fix: Limit her reference to the narrows tally she handled herself.

patches.find: Cut from the same stick, sealed with the same mark, as Asha's token and the satchel from the narrows.
patches.replace: Cut from the same split ash, sealed with the same mark, as the tally in the satchel from the narrows.

open_errors.issue: Ch8 separates two beeswax impressions: the forged dot-and-split one from the dead raider's satchel, and a true one from 'Bhaskaran's gate chest'. In ch12 the dot-and-split impression is called the one 'lifted from Bhaskaran's tally', which is the name of the true one.
open_errors.fix: Name the source as the dead raider's tally.

patches.find: the impression he had lifted from Bhaskaran's tally.
patches.replace: the impression he had lifted from the dead raider's tally.

open_errors.issue: In ch23 Neela says her nails split in her sleep, and Devan sees a nail ragged at the quick. Ch25 says one nail split 'that morning' (the new moon), 'where there had been one this morning', which treats it as the first split.
open_errors.fix: In ch23, make the nails itch and redden but not yet split.

patches.find: Two nights I've skipped. My nails split in my sleep.
patches.replace: Two nights I've skipped. My nails itch at the quick in my sleep.

patches.find: It was pressed hard against the nail of her forefinger, and the nail was ragged at the quick.
patches.replace: It was pressed hard against the nail of her forefinger, and the skin was red at the quick.

open_errors.issue: Neela is locked in one of the kennel cages and counts 'forty-one' cages. In ch28 she feeds forty-one caged animals, so the cage count is one short once her own cage is included.
open_errors.fix: Count forty-two cages in ch26, one of them hers, and make ch28 say 'occupied cage'.

patches.find: She counted the cages. Forty-one. She counted them again.
patches.replace: She counted the cages. Forty-two, and one of them was hers. She counted them again.

patches.find: She forked fodder from the loft into every cage, forty-one of them, and carried the cook-house scraps to the fox and the mongoose.
patches.replace: She forked fodder from the loft into every occupied cage, forty-one of them, and carried the cook-house scraps to the fox and the mongoose.

open_errors.issue: Neela's contract terms in ch1 say 'not before the marriage writ comes back sealed from Kodiyur'. When Ammu says 'the writ is on the road', Neela asks 'What writ?' as though she has no idea.
open_errors.fix: Have her ask to confirm it is the marriage writ.

open_errors.issue: Devan says Muthu's mother's monthly letter 'had come and been answered a fortnight ago'. In ch17, about a week before ch24, Muthu hands Sudhi a grey-sealed letter 'to his mother' on post day while Devan takes the post at the gate.
open_errors.fix: Tie the last answered letter to the last post day.

patches.find: Her letter had come and been answered a fortnight ago.
patches.replace: Her letter had come and been answered on the last post day.

open_errors.issue: Devan hears the cistern chain strike 'the third watch', and then Neela wakes 'well before the middle watch'. The third watch comes after the middle watch, and F188 places her waking after midnight.
open_errors.fix: Put her waking after the middle watch.

patches.find: Well before the middle watch she woke.
patches.replace: Past the middle watch she woke.
